## Triage — current main (00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5)

**Disposition:** still live; keep #6164 open as a design-amendment/decision record. It is not already handled or superseded. No code changes were made.

### Evidence and scoped fix path

- **Board identity conflicts across the design and implementation.** The design says derive the stable ID from `(creator signing key, random nonce)` but leaves the derivation details unstated ([design §1](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/doc/2026-11-01_design_id2054.md#L48-L53)). Current `Board.board_id` is instead a creator-chosen string with only length/character validation ([boards.rs](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/boards.rs#L86-L101), [validator](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/boards.rs#L1540-L1549)). Amend #2054 to choose one contract and, if derivation is chosen, specify domain separator, nonce size/encoding, duplicate behavior, and compatibility for already-published roots.
- **Hash and size behavior is not one uniform contract.** `ArtifactHash` is canonical lower-case SHA-256 ([boards.rs](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/boards.rs#L41-L63)); `DocumentRef` uses BLAKE3 plus a byte length and verifies both ([documents.rs](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/documents.rs#L43-L50), [verification](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/documents.rs#L121-L146)). The design amendment needs a per-class hash/size/verification and compatibility rule for attachments, theme assets, and game packages. In particular, existing signed objects cannot be rewritten in place; spell out any additive migration/new-version path. Current main also has `GamePostRef` pointing at a same-board Post rather than a dedicated GamePost object; PR #6158 is still open and introduces metadata only.
- **Pinned-view provenance is not represented.** Design invariant 5 requires exact board/rules/theme inputs, frontier, and resolution context ([design](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/doc/2026-11-01_design_id2054.md#L91-L102)), while current `BoardView` returns the projection without a receipt/provenance field ([boards.rs](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/00a294ab6a38b23b3a3f855ff5e6102d5aed78c5/pkgs/id/src/boards.rs#L1444-L1463)). Specify the smallest reproducible receipt or explicitly defer it with rationale.

### Blocker and ordering

Resolve these choices in `doc/2026-11-01_design_id2054.md` (linked from #2054) before changing serialized board IDs/hash semantics or relying on saved-view provenance. Do **not** block PR #6158 as scoped; its metadata-only slice must not silently redefine these contracts. Land the amendment/affirmation before unblocking #6160's package/hash-sensitive async-turn work; #6161 follows #6160. #6163 remains separately gated on #5858 and #5679. #6160 is currently blocked and #6161 parked. Keep #6164 open until the design record is updated, then close it as the amendment record.

Partial verification — staying open (2026-11-07 done-task-only audit, tracking: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/7016).

Queue task(s) [10460] were marked done, and some work did land:
- PR #6271 — fix(opencode-claimant): post the launch agent-note via gh (#6257) (merged 2026-11-05T16:03:25Z): https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/6271

No merged change closes this issue's full scope, so the done status is not treated as completion. Remainder re-queued as triage task 11762.
